description: Render complete CSS from a current theme_manifest revision, a unique CSS prefix and optional property overrides. Uses canonical defaults and validates settings. Returns CSS, SHA-256 and application guidance without saving a theme. Load CSS globally and use the prefix in the component's theme property; verify installed typings.

component.description: Component from theme_manifest: scheduler, calendar, month, gantt, kanban, or navigator

prefix.description: CSS prefix: 1–64 lower-case letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore

properties.description: Optional property overrides; booleans for checkbox, integers or canonical integer strings for number, strings for text/color/select. Omitted properties inherit source defaults

revision.description: Required revision returned by theme_manifest for this component

name: render_theme
